en.why_it_matters: The interesting thing here is not simply two famous musicians sharing a bill. Hornsby's restless piano language and songcraft meet McBride's huge bass sound and improvisational reflexes with no band to hide behind, and NJPAC is explicitly presenting the afternoon as a jam and conversation around Hornsby's current album. In the small Victoria Theater, the musical negotiation between piano and bass should be the whole point.
en.trip_verdict: S. Worth a dedicated Newark/NYC-region outing and a reasonable DMV-to-Newark trip if the piano-bass dialogue appeals. Protect the date, but keep it below S+ because the verified context is an intimate special-format festival appearance rather than a premiere, farewell or uniquely historical one-off.

es.why_it_matters: Lo interesante no es simplemente juntar a dos músicos famosos. El lenguaje pianístico inquieto y la escritura de Hornsby se encuentran con el sonido enorme del bajo y los reflejos improvisatorios de McBride sin una banda donde esconderse, y NJPAC presenta explícitamente la tarde como jam y conversación alrededor del disco actual de Hornsby. En el Victoria Theater, pequeño e íntimo, la negociación musical entre piano y bajo debe ser el centro de todo.
